summary: HeartSciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement updating its at-the-market (ATM) offering program with Maxim Group LLC as sales agent, registering up to $4,161,139 of common stock (up to $18,898,747 aggregate after ~$14.1 million already sold). Commission is 3.0% of gross sales price, subject to Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6's one-third public float cap. Shares trade on Nasdaq under HSCS; last sale $3.77 on October 6, 2026. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and float-driven capacity.
